_about: Material level and island archetype rules (docs/design/world-design.md §2–3). The island generator applies ring offsets to the island tier; crafting uses the mean-of-materials rule from the systems PRD §8.4.
_resource_render_note: SWITCH2D (owner 2026-10-21: "keep buildings 3D and make resources 2D"): "card" draws every resource prop as a flat, camera-facing card - the owner's painted sprites (data/world/sprites2d.json) where a family's art is cut, else its baked CARD2D card (data/card2d.json), with data/world/sprites2d_map.json for overrides. "model" is the old 3D GLB look (--models on a lab run). Buildings stay 3D either way.

landing.note: harbour + camp; nothing spawns within 25 m of camp

_wild_level: ASSUMPTION: each level a wild animal sits above its species tier adds this fraction to its health, attack and defense (5 levels = +40 %, ProgressionScaling.LEVEL_STAT_RATE). At or below the tier it keeps its listed stats, so the level-1 starter island is unchanged.

fatigue._about: ASSUMPTION: our own starting values, tune in playtests. Level gap = zone level minus character level. Each level over adds gap_up_rate to every non-baseline fatigue gain, each level under removes gap_down_rate, clamped to [gap_min, gap_max]. Climate fatigue = unmet resistance points x climate_per_min. Window is the seconds a source keeps counting in the breakdown panel.

hunger._about: HUNGER (owner-approved memo docs/design/hunger-and-tribe-automation.md Part 1, 2026-10-29: 'the stomach is a budget, and what fills it is your buff'). Fullness is its own saved value in points (foods.json fullness, cap 100): eating adds it, it decays at decay_per_min whether or not anything digests, and the bands below set the exhaustion multiplier, the meal-buff lifetime and the HUD ring. Digestion still pays Energy over its own 300 s; only the stomach number changed. Every number is an ASSUMPTION (memo 1.4).
hunger._bands: Overfull > well_fed_below (100); Well Fed 70-100; Fed 30-70; Peckish 10-30 (the quick-slot autofeed fires here); Empty < 10 (meal buffs switch off below buff_off_below).

fatigue_mult._about: Multiplies every fatigue gain (the idle baseline too) by the stomach state (Digestion.state_for). ASSUMPTION; overfull is a small sluggish penalty, starving the empty band after starving_after_s.

fullness_classes._about: Fullness a food class is worth (foods.json 'fullness'): raw fruit and berries are a snack (6-10, 'snack': true, no buff), simple cooked food 25-30, dishes with roles 45-60, feast-tier dishes (later) 80+. ASSUMPTION: no shipped dish is feast tier yet.

xp._about: XPECON (islands-and-loop plan section 3.3 'XP economy' + 3.4 knobs): a gather pass pays gather_base + round(its own pass seconds), so a slower node or bare hands pays more and a better tool or skill pays less; a build pays build_first the first time that kit kind is ever placed (memory is World.pioneer_buildings, saved) and build_repeat after that; a build of the same kind within build_spam_radius_m of a standing one of its kind placed less than build_spam_seconds ago pays 0. The level curve stays World.xp_for_level.

gathering_downrank: node level above Gathering skill level is reduced to the skill level
crafted_level: floor(mean of consumed material levels), clamped by governing skill level and recipe max_level

crafting._about: Spec 04 'Crafting skill vs crafting ability' and plan 3.3 'Crafting'. success = clamp(1-(shortfall/100)^2, 0, 1), shortfall = max(0, required_ability - crafting_ability) (0 -> 100 %, 50 -> 75 %, 80 -> 36 %, 100 -> 0 %). CRAFTFEEL note: a recipe without required_ability needs only its min_level (the category-level gate), so today's recipes stay at 100 % (the skewer of spec 25 8 is 100 %); a recipe that declares required_ability can fall short and fail. CRAFTFEEL data (review round 1): every recipe with min_level >= 8 declares required_ability = min_level + 40 (35 recipes, the four min_level 55 raid pieces take 95); this is an ASSUMPTION (gate level + a fixed shortfall headroom), not a balance pass, and every value can be retuned in data alone. The lowest shipped success at a recipe's own gate is 0.840 (raid_maul). A failed craft spends the picked instances and yields nothing (spec 25 8 'if crafting fails, materials disappear'). Flawless is a separate roll on a successful craft (spec 04; its 5 % is plan 3.3's value).
crafting._flawless: A flawless craft keeps its level (a preview must equal the result) and gains stat_bonus: durability x1.1, attributes.quality 'flawless', flags.flawless. flawless_level_bonus only applies to a recipe that sets flawless_level: true.

gear_traits._about: TRAITGEAR (docs/design/tools-durability-crafting.md 3.6, P4; open question TD10): the primary material's traits change the crafted gear's stats. per_level is a fraction per trait level; the sum on one stat clamps at +-cap (the structural-trait cap of WildLandsMMO_Crafting_Building_Math.md). Only gear crafted after P4 (attributes.trait_stats) reads them. # ASSUMPTION: every number here; TD9 traits (lightweight, compact_structure, pointy, sharp_section, full) feed no gear stat yet.

unstable_flag: all materials from unstable islands until cargo-warped

reset._about: ISLAND RESET (docs/design/island-resources.md sections 5.4 and 5.5, A1 + A2). Expedition islands live lifetime_hours by tier band (6/12/24 h of play); every started clock counts down while the game runs on any island, never while it is closed. At 0 the island rerolls a new layout (generation + 1).
reset._regen_note: # ASSUMPTION (doc 5.4): ambient and habitat nodes on an expedition island regrow 5x slower than on home (60-240 s becomes 5-20 min).
reset._trickle_note: # ASSUMPTION (doc 5.4): an expedition landmark node with any units left regains one per 10 min; taken to 0 it stays empty until the reset.
reset._home_note: # ASSUMPTION (doc 5.4): a spent home landmark pool refills after one in-game day (Game.day_length_seconds 720).
reset._refund_note: A1 (approved; # ASSUMPTION on the share): a placed building left on an island at its reset refunds 50 % of its kit recipe (rounded down per slot) to the home vault; its storage moves there whole.

unstable_isles._about: UNSTABLE ISLES (docs/design/unstable-isles.md): generated, short-life islands. One at a time: it rolls from a seed (level band, climate, shape family, size), sits on the harbour board for offer_window_s, lives life_s of play once landed, then sinks for good. All numbers # ASSUMPTION.
unstable_isles._regen_note: Ambient nodes effectively do not regrow inside the 40-minute life (100x the home time).

fire_weather._about: WEATHER x FIREPITS (scripts/world/fire_weather.gd, owner 2026-10-28: 'have rain affect fire somehow', 'fires under a roof will build up smoke', 'the smoke should make you take damage'). Unsheltered fires burn fuel_mult times faster and wear wear_mult times faster in each rain mode; the stone firepit feels permanent_share of that. Pouring rain and storms soak a temporary fire (out at 1: about 90 s of pouring, 60 s of storm); the firepit soaks at permanent_soak_share (about 5 min of pouring). A roof over the fire keeps all of that off, but smoke pools under it toward open_floor + (1 - open_floor) x enclosure over rise_s and clears over vent_s; from hurt_from it gives Smoke Inhalation within radius_m, stacks at stack_at. No lighting in light_block modes without a roof. ASSUMPTION: every number.

weather._about: WEATHER (scripts/world/world_weather.gd, weather_fx.gd, lightning_bolt.gd). Every rain_check_s the island rolls its climate's 'rain' chance; a spell is a storm (pouring plus lightning) on its 'storm' roll, else a mode from the climate's 'modes' weights (default_modes when it has none). A strike lands at a world point lightning_bands away from the survivor ([share, min m, max m]: some close, most mid, some far); its thunder lands that distance / sound_mps later and shakes harder the nearer it was. Shakes are camera offsets in metres (14 m view height: 0.1 m is about 6 px at 900 px). ASSUMPTION: chances and weights follow climates.json's weather lists (no rain where it lists none); timings keep the old 18 s every 50-90 s rain; strikes damage nothing.

drying._note: Wet dries a stack per its duration in the open; x(1 + heat_mult x heat) in heat, + fire_mult within fire_m of a burning fire. ASSUMPTION.

harbour._about: The harbour stands on the coast (HarbourSite). Its 3x6 footprint's landward row 0 is on land, every cell from dock_from_row to the tip is over water (so the base is within dock_from_row metres of the shoreline), and the tip is at least boat_depth_m below the water line. A pose that breaks this is refused: island build snaps to the nearest legal coast, BuildGrid.can_place answers dock_needs_water / needs_shore. The island json 'harbour' is a hint plus the travel arrival point; t_harbour keeps it on the resolved site.
